shared_core.purpose: Correct Phase-2 revision, causality, ensemble-atomicity and evidence-publication defects without mutating frozen v1 semantics in place.

immutable_predecessor.rule: The v1 contract and historical v1 evidence remain immutable audit history. Repairs are implemented only under explicit successor versions.

repository_roles.janwohlers78/mardorf-data-collector: provider acquisition, provider-native metadata preservation, availability declarations, integrity and verified transfer
repository_roles.janwohlers78/mardorf-kitevorhersage: private revalidation, revision/event archive, causal views, analysis adapters and decision handoff

identity_and_revision_model.logical_forecast_identity: Stable meteorological forecast identity: model/stream, member identity where applicable, run time, valid time and grid point. Retrieval product enrichment does not create another logical forecast.
identity_and_revision_model.content_revision_id: Deterministic hash of meteorological/status content with acquisition/private visibility clocks excluded.
identity_and_revision_model.revision_event_id: Identity of one observed source/provider occurrence of a content revision. It is distinct from content_revision_id and MUST preserve a later return to previously seen content.
identity_and_revision_model.exact_replay_identity: An exact replay of the same source occurrence MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT create a new revision event.
identity_and_revision_model.aba_rule: A -> B -> A with a genuinely later provider/source occurrence MUST remain three ordered revision events even though the first and third content_revision_id values are equal.
identity_and_revision_model.ordering_rule: Latest/as_of selection MUST order revision events by causal source/provider occurrence semantics subject to private visibility. private first_seen is a visibility gate, not the meteorological revision ordering key.

causality_and_as_of.private_visibility_rule: No record, field metadata, availability event, ensemble source revision or evidence object may be visible before its private first_seen/verified visibility time.
causality_and_as_of.as_of_rule: connect_archive(..., as_of=T) and every successor causal reader MUST expose only revision events and metadata privately known by T.
causality_and_as_of.revision_binding_rule: Field values and field availability metadata exposed for a selected forecast revision MUST belong to that revision event or to an explicitly versioned event relation causally valid for that revision.
causality_and_as_of.metadata_leak_rule: A later privately-known metadata/source revision MUST NOT inherit an earlier first_seen merely because logical field identity and availability status are unchanged.
causality_and_as_of.current_latest_rule: Current latest views MUST represent the latest causal revision event, not the last unique content hash ever stored.

field_availability_contract.successor_requirement: A new availability contract version is required.
field_availability_contract.availability_event_identity: Availability observations MUST have an event identity bound to the applicable record/revision event and source evidence.
field_availability_contract.first_seen_semantics: first_seen_at_utc is the earliest private visibility time of that specific availability event/metadata revision. It MUST NOT be reused across different metadata/source revisions.
field_availability_contract.unknown_behavior: Missing or ambiguous availability remains explicit and cannot be converted to received/clear/zero.

ensemble_revision_contract.successor_requirement: A new ensemble storage/view contract version is required.
ensemble_revision_contract.source_revision_set_id: Each ensemble system/run/valid-time/field exposure MUST identify one coherent source revision set.
ensemble_revision_contract.atomic_member_selection: Member values, member availability and member-derived aggregates exposed together MUST come from the same selected source revision set.
ensemble_revision_contract.partial_revision_rule: A partial later source revision MUST NOT be silently completed with members from an older source revision.
ensemble_revision_contract.old_source_replay_rule: Later private replay of an older provider/source occurrence MUST NOT displace a newer provider/source occurrence.
ensemble_revision_contract.exact_replay_rule: Exact replay of the same ensemble source event is idempotent and MUST NOT advance meteorological revision chronology or earliest private visibility.
ensemble_revision_contract.aggregate_provenance_rule: Member-derived aggregates MUST retain the exact member revision set from which they were computed.
ensemble_revision_contract.independence_rule: Control, full ensemble, provider summaries and compatibility projections remain representations within their meteorological model_family unless an explicit future contract states otherwise.

native_time_interval_contract.rule: Accumulation, average and maximum fields MUST preserve enough native metadata to reconstruct the exact provider interval. Missing interval boundaries MUST NOT be guessed.

evidence_publication_contract.general_rule: Immutable evidence events and mutable/high-water indexes MUST be separate concepts with explicit publication semantics.

gefs_cycle_evidence.immutable_event_rule: Each distinct GEFS cycle/source evidence event is written to a content/event-addressed immutable path.
gefs_cycle_evidence.index_rule: A separate latest/high-water index may advance monotonically and MUST use deterministic merge/CAS semantics.
gefs_cycle_evidence.forbidden: Rewriting a path classified as immutable with changed bytes, or treating a mutable high-water file as immutable without a merge contract.

evidence_publication_contract.bundle_atomicity_rule: A publication conflict in evidence/index handling MUST fail the whole dependent bundle rather than publishing mismatched pointers/manifests.

transfer_contract.verified_payload_rule: Existing SHA-256 and byte-length verification of the decompressed public payload remains mandatory.
transfer_contract.receipt_rule: Private promotion remains receipt-bound and readback-verified.
transfer_contract.scope_note: A verified transfer does not prove archive revision or evidence-publication correctness; those are separate successor gates.

provider_native_semantics.rule: Provider-native parameter identity, units, level, product, run/valid identity and native interval metadata remain authoritative evidence and MUST survive transfer/persistence.
provider_native_semantics.semantic_mapping_rule: Any registry semantic successor MUST not merge meteorologically non-equivalent native fields without an explicit derived-field definition and provenance.

family_independence.primary_contribution_rule: Family-weighted analysis may accept at most one primary contribution per model_family after within-family selection/aggregation.
non_independent_examples: GFS and GEFS-control/full NOAA_GEFS do not create extra independent GFS-family evidence merely by representation count.
Deterministic ICON, ICON-D2-EPS and compatibility projections do not create extra independent DWD-ICON-family evidence merely by representation count.

phase3_gate.rule: Meteorology Feature Broker implementation MUST NOT become the operational Archive consumer before all three causality gates pass.

migration_and_backfill.no_history_rewrite: Existing v1-v4 Parquet and historical frozen contracts are not rewritten in place.
migration_and_backfill.replay_rule: Where exact successor fields/events are missing, backfill/replay MUST use retained provider/source evidence; values, interval boundaries, revision chronology or first_seen times MUST NOT be invented.
migration_and_backfill.legacy_read_rule: Legacy compatibility reads may remain available but MUST NOT claim stronger causality/revision guarantees than the stored evidence supports.

required_acceptance_invariants: A -> B -> A is preserved as three revision events while exact same-source replay is idempotent.
Historical as_of cannot expose metadata or source evidence first known privately after the cutoff.
An old ensemble source replay cannot replace a newer provider/source revision.
A visible ensemble member set is revision-atomic and never mixes old/new source revisions silently.
GEFS native accumulation/average/maximum interval boundaries survive member-table persistence.
GEFS cycle evidence can be carried/re-published without immutable-path byte conflict.
No missing or ambiguous field is zero-filled or treated as false-clear.
Provider-native field identity and source provenance remain queryable through successor views.

change_control.v2_shared_core_mutation_rule: Any change to shared_core requires a new shared_core_sha256, matching byte-identical contract update in both repositories, and an explicit audit-plan reason.
change_control.implementation_rule: Implementation steps C1 onward may satisfy this contract but may not weaken these invariants without a new contract version.
change_control.refreeze_rule: Status may become complete_frozen only after H1 and H2 acceptance gates and H3 explicit refreeze.

cape_native_identity.safety_rule: CAPE list order is non-semantic; native model/parameter/level/product identity must be resolved before hazard use.
cape_native_identity.ambiguity_rule: unresolved or conflicting CAPE identity is unknown/warn and MUST NOT be represented as false/clear
cape_native_identity.positive_rule: any identified native CAPE candidate at or above the configured threshold is conservative positive hazard evidence
cape_native_identity.provenance_rule: selected hazard candidate carries its native CAPE identity into the operational C3 slot

native_interval_precedence: explicit interval_start_utc/interval_end_utc when complete and valid-time consistent
canonical_gust_v2.alias_rule: 10fg, 10fg3 and 10fg6 names do not imply duration; duration is resolved from native step metadata.
canonical_gust_v2.unresolved_rule: missing, incomplete, conflicting or invalid interval evidence remains unknown/ambiguous and MUST NOT be converted to a zero-duration point interval.
canonical_gust_v2.value_binding_rule: the numerical derived gust must be bound to matching provider-native gust evidence within documented collector rounding tolerance before interval metadata is attached.
canonical_gust_v2.verification_rule: SVG gust truth aggregates the complete canonical gust interval and requires every constituent complete hourly observation; it MUST NOT compare a 3h/6h model maximum only with the final observation hour.
canonical_gust_v2.backward_compatibility: canonical_record_v1 remains retained for historical compatibility but is not the preferred analytical record for new promoted snapshots.
